hadith:
Knowledge - Narrated Ibn `Abbas:

Somebody said to the Prophet (during his last Hajj), "I did the slaughtering before doing the Rami.' The Prophet (ﷺ) beckoned with his hand and said, "There is no harm in that." Then another person said. "I got my head shaved before offering the sacrifice." The Prophet (ﷺ) beckoned with his hand saying, "There is no harm in that."
message: The signs of Allah's creation around us and within ourselves are clear proofs of His wisdom for those who believe with certainty, inviting us to reflect on His majesty. Just as Allah is An Noor, The Light, He illuminates our path through faith and guidance, helping us navigate life's complexities with clarity and purpose. Let us embrace this spiritual light by being flexible and merciful in our dealings with others, recognizing that there is no harm in honest mistakes when our intentions are sincere.
name:
An Noor - النُّورُ - The Light

The name An Noor originates from the Arabic word 'Noor', which means light. It is associated with the Quranic verse that highlights Allah as the source of light in both the physical and spiritual realms. This name encourages reflection on the guidance and clarity that faith provides to individuals, illuminating their path in life.
verse:
Al-Jathiyah - The Crouching - 45:4

And in your own creation, and whatever living beings He dispersed, are signs for people of sure faith.
